Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.vm

Class Frame

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.vm.Frame
public final class Frame extends Object
One activation of a Mandela body.

A frame owns its slots (parameters, locals and the two machine slots of a method), its capture cells, its instruction pointer, the try handlers currently installed and the defer bodies still owed. The operand stack is not per frame: frames share the machine's stack and record where theirs starts, which is what makes an unwind a single assignment to the stack pointer instead of a per-frame cleanup.

Frames are chained rather than kept in a collection, so a stack trace is a walk and a call is one allocation. Nothing here is thread-safe by design; one VM runs one script on one thread.
